title: Quit India: resolution, slogans, more detail

boxes.title: The resolution
items: CWC empowered Gandhi to lead a non-violent mass movement
AICC demands: ==immediate end of British rule==; **provisional government** after British left; mass civil disobedience under Gandhi
Phrase "Quit India": Gandhi in **Harijan** (**April 1942**); coinage usually credited to ==**Yusuf Meherally**==

boxes.title: Slogans & coiners
head: Slogan
By
rows: "Freedom is within our reach... hold it very tight"
"Partition fell on us like a bomb"

boxes.title: Repression & underground: added
items: Zero Hour left the movement ==leaderless and spontaneous==
Gandhi's fast was against state violence → **three** Viceroy's Executive Council members resigned
Sabotage of bridges, rail tracks, telegraph lines, esp. **UP** and **Bihar**
Others underground: **Biju Patnaik**, Chhotubhai Puranik, **Achyut Patwardhan**, **Sucheta Kripalani**, R.P. Goenka

cards.title: Tamluk
lines: Cyclone relief, school grants, paddy distribution

boxes.title: Andhra: more
head: Item
Detail
rows: Signal wires cut / post office burnt
**N.G. Ranga**'s grain seized, **Nidudavolu**; exempt: Muslims, Christians, **SCs**, govt staff

boxes.title: Parties & significance
items: Communists backed war effort after Nazi attack on **USSR**; lost heavily in **1945-46** elections
==Gandhi's final mass movement==; independence could not be postponed after the war
Andhra: "final, decisive event"; **Tanguturi Prakasam** emerged as leading figure
